steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", "notacolumn!", "c" FROM t1')
steps.expect: {CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", 'notacolumn!', "c" FROM t1}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", "not''a''column!", "c" FROM t1')
steps.expect: {CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", 'not''a''column!', "c" FROM t1}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", "not""a""column!", "c" FROM t1')
steps.expect: {CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "a", "b", 'not"a"column!', "c" FROM t1}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "val", count("b") FROM t1 GROUP BY "abc"')
steps.expect: {CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT 'val', count("b") FROM t1 GROUP BY 'abc'}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE TABLE xyz(a CHECK (a!="str"), b AS (a||"str"))')
SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE INDEX i1 ON t1(a || "str", "b", "val")')
SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE TRIGGER tr AFTER INSERT ON t1 BEGIN SELECT "abcd"; END')
steps.expect: {CREATE TRIGGER tr AFTER INSERT ON t1 BEGIN SELECT 'abcd'; END}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT "string"''alias'' FROM t1')
steps.expect: {CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT 'string' 'alias' FROM t1}

steps.sql: SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE INDEX i1 ON t1(a) WHERE "b"="bb"')
SELECT sqlite_rename_quotefix('main', 'CREATE TABLE t2(abc, xyz CHECK (xyz != "123"))')
